description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Banking Act, No. 30 Of 1988, as amended Limited for Accommodation Granted to Related Parties of Licensed Banks.
categorisation: This gazette content contains a regulatory order published by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka under the Banking Act, establishing limits for accommodation granted to related parties of licensed banks. It involves legal/regulatory matters including statutory instruments, compliance requirements, and amendments to banking regulations, which falls under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5).
